g.text: Remember that game I was telling you about with Amir?
Hey Aoi! You like Amir, right?
You're a fan of games, right Aoi?
I feel like I screwed up asking you if you'd like to join. I'm sorry. We'd really love it if you joined the game with us.
Could you just please join? Amir won't stop bothering me about it.
Amir's trying to get a game of "Fables & Frontiers" together. It's a board game where everybody makes characters and plays pretend.
Amir's trying to get a game of "Fables & Frontiers" together. It's a game where we all tell a story together and use chance to add some excitement to it.
... i was actually really hoping u'd ask again
like what kind of play pretend? ... r people gonna make fun of me for playing?
count me in!! oh oh oh do you think he'll let me play a character that has pets?
Eh, it's just a silly game. It's a waste of time but I'm trying to be nice.
If they do, they'll have to go through me. <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>
Who cares? It'll be fun! And it'll mean a lot to Amir.
LOL. I think you can play as a druid, yeah. They have familiars. Like cats and things.
i think it'll mean the world to amir to have everybody around the table playing... he's like me. big heart <3
